headline: Marcos Establishes National Critical Minerals Framework Under EO 122
seoTitle: Marcos Establishes Critical Minerals Framework Under EO 122 | FMB News
seoDescription: Executive Order No. 122 establishes a national critical minerals framework prioritizing domestic processing, responsible mining and downstream manufacturing.
deck: The new policy seeks to move more Philippine mineral value into domestic processing and manufacturing while tightening coordination, environmental safeguards and permit accountability.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. issued Executive Order No. 122 establishing a unified national policy framework for the development of the Philippines' critical minerals sector.

The framework prioritizes exploration, responsible development, domestic processing and downstream manufacturing for minerals important to clean energy, batteries, electronics, digital infrastructure and national security.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The policy covers strategically important resources including nickel, copper, cobalt and chromite. It directs government agencies to improve coordination and support more value-added activity inside the Philippines rather than relying primarily on raw mineral exports.

The order also strengthens sustainable-mining requirements, community protections and accountability for dormant or non-compliant mining tenements. Investment incentives for qualified value-added activities remain governed by applicable investment and tax laws.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: The Philippines is a major mineral producer but captures less economic value when ores leave the country before refining or manufacturing. Building domestic processing capacity could deepen local supply chains and employment, but it also raises infrastructure, energy, environmental and community-governance requirements.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Implementation details from DENR, MGB, DTI, BOI and the reorganized Mining Industry Coordinating Council will determine which projects qualify, how permits are streamlined and how environmental and community safeguards are enforced.
